name: Cat Grid: Cozy Logic
subtitle: A little logic. A lot of cats.
shortDescription: Find every cat in a cozy logic puzzle. Play offline, in English or Arabic.
description:
A little logic. A lot of cats.

Find one cat in every row, column and colour. There is one more rule: cats cannot touch, even diagonally. Tap to cross out an empty cell, double-tap to place a cat, and let each discovery lead you to the next.

START SMALL, THINK BIG
The first five levels help you by automatically crossing out cells after you find a cat. From level six, your grown-up whiskers take over: mark the board yourself.

TRY AN IDEA
Use coloured test inks to explore a possibility without losing a fish. Undo marks, clear a test colour, or commit your idea when you are ready.

YOUR DAILY CAT BREAK
Play progressively larger puzzles and a daily challenge generated on your device. Earn in-game hints and helper rewards as you complete levels.

MAKE YOURSELF COMFORTABLE
Play in Arabic or English. Choose calm mode for less motion, add region patterns, and adjust music, sound and vibration in Settings.

Works offline. No account, ads, tracking, or in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device.
promotionalText: Find the cats, follow the clues, and give your whiskers a little workout. Offline logic puzzles in Arabic and English.
